name: Camp Akeela
description_short: Overnight camp for neurodivergent kids who have finished grades 3 to 10 (ages 9 to 17), on Miller Pond near Thetford Center, Vermont. Campers do a traditional camp program while staff coach social skills. Two three-week sessions in 2027; tuition is all-inclusive apart from baggage shipping and the optional ride home, and includes a one-way bus to camp.
special_needs_notes: Built for neurodivergent campers, many with autism (Level 1), ADHD or NLD; no diagnosis is required. Campers must manage daily living with some prompting and live in a cabin of up to 9 campers with 4 counselors. The camp says it is not the right fit for kids who need one-to-one behavioral support or have a history of aggression, running away or recent psychiatric hospitalization. Families and directors decide fit together during the application.

warnings: The page also lists a separate Family Camp (Aug 12–17, 2027, $4400, plus $750 per person for guests beyond 4; cabins hold up to 10). This is a family program, not a camper session, so it is not included in sessions.
Beyond Akeela 2027 sessions are listed as TBA and are not recorded.
Financial aid comes from outside organizations (CampLauncher, ESS). The camp itself offers payment plans.
The camp has a winter office at 314 Bryn Mawr Avenue, Bala Cynwyd, PA 19004 (Sept 1 – May 31). The address recorded is the Vermont summer camp address.

refund_policy_summary: $1,000 deposit with the application, refunded if camp or family decides the child won't attend. Half the balance is due January 31, 2027 and the rest April 30. Without the optional $500 assurance plan, everything is refundable less a $250 fee until January 31; after that cancellation fees rise from $2,500 to $6,000, and nothing is refunded from June 1. The assurance plan gives a fuller refund up to May 1 and partial credit after.
